Upstream source license: MIT OR Apache-2.0. The MIT license is retained alongside this notice.

Section Designer's native TypeScript implementation was developed after reviewing
CADCraft's feature descriptions, Rust command specifications and geometric workflows,
including its fillet/chamfer kept-side conventions. The command inventory includes
upstream command names/labels and source locations for planning and attribution.

This does not bundle or run CADCraft's Rust/WebAssembly engine. No upstream brand
assets, icons, fonts or external DWG libraries are redistributed. This integration
is independent and is not endorsed by ArtCraft or Autodesk. CADCraft and AutoCAD
names are used to identify the reference project and familiar workflow respectively.

Implemented scope and remaining work: ../../CADCRAFT_INTEGRATION.md.
